text: On the day of the immersion, offer Vinayaka the lamp, incense, flowers and naivedyam, and give him harathi.
Then fold your hands and pray to him lovingly: “Vinayaka… accept our worship and bless us.
Return now to your own place, and come again to our home next year.”
❤️ Say this mantra as you offer akshatas or a flower.
Then bow to him and carry him to the immersion.
మా పూజను స్వీకరించి మమ్మల్ని ఆశీర్వదించు వినాయకా.
మళ్ళీ వచ్చే సంవత్సరం మా ఇంటికి రావాలి. ❤️
